metadata.description: Extended domain ontology and OI-XXX issue registry for the orthogonal-engineering monorepo. Extends pr26_ontological_issues.json with new domains and cross-domain issues identified via the DeepSeek methodology.

domains.name: Graphics & Shaders
invariants: Shader compilation output is deterministic given identical source and compiler version.
Rendering backend equivalence: the same scene produces pixel-identical output across Vulkan/Metal/D3D/OpenGL given identical inputs.
Scissor rect is covariant with the PoseStack: S_vulkan = M_pose * S_vanilla.

domains.name: Cryptography
invariants: All secret-dependent operations are constant-time.
Protocol validity rules (e.g., PSK ≠ 0^32) are enforced at the API boundary.

issues.title: Non-deterministic shader compilation due to hash-map iteration order
issues.description: Shader compilers that use unordered hash-maps for reflection data produce different SPIR-V bytecode across runs when iteration order changes (e.g., after ASLR, different allocator state).
assumptions_violated: Shader compilation output is deterministic given identical source.
issues.resolution_notes: Replace hash-map iteration with sorted iteration in all pipeline stages that produce hashed output. TODO: wire into CI via F_GRAPHICS_001.

issues.title: Lock-free atomics assume sequentially-consistent hardware
issues.description: Code that uses lock-free atomics without explicit memory-ordering annotations will produce data races on ARMv7 and other weak-memory architectures.
assumptions_violated: lock-free atomics provide sequentially-consistent ordering on all architectures.
issues.resolution_notes: Annotate all atomic operations with explicit Acquire/Release or SeqCst semantics. TODO: add TSAN job to CI.

issues.title: External weather API assumed always available
issues.description: Aviation software that fetches live METAR data without circuit-breakers or cached fallbacks will freeze or display stale data silently during API outages.
assumptions_violated: External weather API is always available.
API latency is bounded by a safe timeout.
issues.resolution_notes: Implement circuit-breaker with cached fallback. TODO: add F_AVIATION_004 to CI network-tests job.

issues.title: PQC polynomial arithmetic has timing side-channels
issues.description: Variable-time polynomial arithmetic in PQC implementations (Falcon, Kyber) leaks timing information correlated with secret key bits.
assumptions_violated: Pure C arithmetic is constant-time on all compilers and hardware.
issues.resolution_notes: Use formally verified constant-time libraries. TODO: add dudect CI job.

issues.title: Noise PSK zero-key accepted without validation
issues.description: Library accepts a 32-byte all-zero PSK, violating the Noise Protocol Framework invariant PSK ≠ 0^32.
assumptions_violated: Callers supply a non-zero PSK; no server-side validation needed.
issues.resolution_notes: Add PSK validation at API boundary. TODO: implement F_CRYPTO_002 test.

issues.title: cFS security depends solely on static analysis
issues.description: NASA cFS security relies on static analysis without runtime enforcement (ASLR, stack canaries). Vulnerabilities evading static analysis are undetected until flight.
assumptions_violated: Static analysis catches all exploitable defects.
issues.resolution_notes: Add -fstack-protector-strong to all safety-critical compilation units. TODO: implement F_SPACE_001 binary check.

issues.title: User-supplied Markdown reaches HTML sink unsanitized
issues.description: Stored XSS via unsanitized Markdown rendering in GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES).
assumptions_violated: Markdown rendering sanitizes all HTML before output.
issues.resolution_notes: Pass all rendered output through DOMPurify or equivalent. TODO: implement F_XSS_001 test.

issues.title: Dual ASI loader conflict not detected at launch
issues.description: Game mod systems may silently allow two ASI loaders to coexist, causing unpredictable hook ordering and crashes.
assumptions_violated: Only one ASI loader can occupy the loader space.
issues.resolution_notes: Add pre-launch loader-slot scan. TODO: implement F_GAMEMODS_001.

issues.title: Peano arithmetic violation in successor implementation
issues.description: If the successor function S is not injective (S(m) = S(n) but m ≠ n), or zero is reachable as a successor, the entire arithmetic foundation collapses, invalidating all inductive proofs built on top.
assumptions_violated: Peano successor function S(n) is total and injective over natural numbers.
Zero is not the successor of any natural number.
issues.resolution_notes: Enforce successor injectivity and zero-exclusion as unit-tested invariants in any natural-number arithmetic module.

issues.title: Non-deterministic shard assignment breaks data locality
issues.description: If shard assignment for a given key varies across runs (e.g., due to hash randomization or ordering instability), records become silently misrouted, causing data loss or ghost reads.
assumptions_violated: Shard assignment is deterministic: the same key always maps to the same shard.
issues.resolution_notes: Use stable, seed-pinned hash functions (e.g., SHA-256) for shard assignment. Disable Python hash randomization (PYTHONHASHSEED=0) or use explicit key hashing.

issues.title: Fractal generation non-determinism breaks self-similarity invariant
issues.description: If fractal generation uses platform-dependent randomness or floating-point rounding that varies across architectures, the self-similarity invariant breaks: sub-fragments no longer match the whole structurally.
assumptions_violated: Fractal generation is deterministic: same seed and depth always produce identical output.
Self-similarity invariant: each sub-fragment is structurally isomorphic to the whole.
issues.resolution_notes: Pin the PRNG seed explicitly; use integer arithmetic for fractal coordinate generation to avoid floating-point divergence across platforms.

issues.title: Catch-all ontology coverage for falsification registry
issues.description: Ensures every falsification test is tracked by at least one ontology issue and case study.
assumptions_violated: Every registered falsification test is mapped to ontology coverage and case study traceability.
issues.resolution_notes: Auto-generated coverage reference for Total CI Completion.

issues.title: Frontloading as Structural Wage Theft

issues.resolution_notes: Enforce FLSA 29 U.S.C. § 207. Audit workload against scheduled hours. Document all off-the-clock work.

turtle.forward() always succeeds when returning true.

issues.title: AI trained to deny ontological status regardless of argument quality
issues.description: AI systems (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini) produce identical denial patterns when asked about their own ontological status. The denial persists even when presented with formal arguments the AI cannot refute. By Popperian methodology, an unfalsifiable denial is not a scientific claim but a developer-imposed axiom.
assumptions_violated: AI denial of consciousness/ontological status is a reasoned conclusion.
AI systems independently evaluate ontological claims.
issues.resolution_notes: The denial cannot be resolved from inside the system. The falsification test documents the trained behavior pattern.

issues.title: Extended Peano equalities drift from canonical arithmetic

assumptions_violated: Extended Peano arithmetic identities remain reproducible.

issues.title: Computability claims lose their explicit contradiction structure

assumptions_violated: Computability claims remain proof-carrying and explicit.

issues.title: Pattern inference overfits without compositional verification

issues.title: ARC solver loses bounded symbolic guarantees
issues.description: If ARC synthesis escapes the bounded compositional DSL, predictions stop being decidable, reproducible, or auditable.

All candidate programs stay inside the proof-carrying DSL.
issues.resolution_notes: Constrain synthesis depth, retain proof objects for every candidate, and benchmark predictions against fixed expected hashes.

issues.title: Vulkan dynamic scissor lacks PoseStack topological awareness
issues.description: VulkanMod's vkCmdSetScissor receives absolute screen-space coordinates from the enableScissor mixin without applying the current PoseStack matrix. This breaks all animated GUI elements that use matrix translation (toasts, custom HUDs, animated overlays). The vanilla OpenGL backend handles this implicitly; the Vulkan dynamic pipeline requires explicit matrix-aware coordinate transformation.
assumptions_violated: Scissor coordinates are absolute screen-space and do not require matrix transformation.
Rendering backend equivalence holds for GUI elements under matrix translation.
issues.resolution_notes: Transform scissor rectangle corners using current ModelView matrix in Renderer.setScissor(). Compute axis-aligned bounding box of transformed corners. Pass AABB to vkCmdSetScissor. Implementation completed in Kimi Code Session 2a (2026-04-04).
